name: Telegram
description: Telegram bot integration for triggering flows on incoming messages, asking questions with waiting replies, or sending outbound messages.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Operation Mode

options.label: Ask Question (Pauses flow & awaits user reply)

inputs.helpText: Choose whether this node triggers on new Telegram messages, pauses execution awaiting a reply, or sends an outbound message.

inputs.name: question
inputs.label: Question / Message Content
inputs.defaultValue: Please review this request and reply directly to this message.
inputs.helpText: The message text to send to the user on Telegram.

inputs.name: chatId
inputs.label: Telegram Chat ID / User ID
inputs.helpText: The recipient Telegram chat ID or user ID.

inputs.name: botToken
inputs.label: Telegram Bot Token (Optional)
inputs.placeholder: 123456:ABC-DEF... (Leave blank to use token configured in Settings)
inputs.helpText: Optional custom bot token from @BotFather. If omitted, uses Telegram Bot Token configured in Settings.

inputs.name: timeoutMs
inputs.label: Wait Timeout (ms)
inputs.helpText: Maximum wait time in milliseconds before timing out when awaiting a reply (default: 24h).
